INSERT INTO file_info (name, path, size, is_dir, mtime, ctime, atime, owner_user, owner_group, owner_uid, owner_gid, perm_posix, perm_acl_mode, perm_acl, mount_point_type, indexed) VALUES
(#{item.name}, #{item.path}, #{item.size}, #{item.isDir}, FROM_UNIXTIME(#{item.mtime}), FROM_UNIXTIME(#{item.ctime}), FROM_UNIXTIME(#{item.atime}), #{item.ownerUser}, #{item.ownerGroup}, #{item.ownerUid}, #{item.ownerGid}, #{item.permPosix}, #{item.permAclMode}, #{item.permAcl}, #{item.mountPointType}, #{item.indexed})
